description:
Move `jit validate` without `--fix`, `--fix --dry-run`, the other readers of the validation capture, `jit doc check-links`, profile planning, profile difference reports and the `profile add` and `profile pack` dry runs onto `with_read_session`, each over the same capture-and-derive function its publishing operation runs, so these reads run beside writers, and state the read discipline in `docs/reference/storage-format.md` (`@/charter/D-20`, `@/charter/D-22`).

## Background

- `capture_validation_image_with` (`crates/jit/src/commands/validate.rs:146-166`) and `capture_validation_report` (`:500-539`) open `with_mutation_session` and return `SessionStep::Done`. `capture_validation_image` (`:130`) serves `image_plan_content` (`:1515-1524`, callers `:1489`, `:1823`) and `validate_rule` (`:1868-1880`, CLI at `crates/jit/src/main.rs:5995`).
- External 1f24e3e9, which this task follows, makes `validate_with_fix` (`validate.rs:42`) derive every `--fix` fix from one validation capture, publish them through one mutation, and derive the same plan without publishing under `--dry-run`. `validate-fix-readiness-convergence` replaces that derivation's readiness step, a different part of the function from the session parameter this task retypes; whichever lands second rebases. Before 1f24e3e9 lands, `--fix --dry-run` reaches `repair_derived_state(true)` (`:72`, `:552-600`). After it, `repair_derived_state` (deriving through `capture_repair_plan`, `:603`) is called only by `jit recover` (`execute_recover`, `crates/jit/src/commands/claim.rs:725`), which publishes. `validate --fix --dry-run` is not recovery-dispatched (`crates/jit/src/cli.rs:2675`).
- `check_document_links` (`crates/jit/src/commands/document.rs:1098-1360`) reads documents through `read_documents_at_named_versions` (`:1369-1396`, called at `:1161`), which opens `with_mutation_session` (`:1380`), captures with `capture_discovering` over `link_check_capture_spec` (`:1424`) and returns `SessionStep::Done(read_documents(..))` (`:1390`). The CLI arm is `crates/jit/src/main.rs:5065-5072`; CLI tests are in `crates/jit/tests/cli_query_graph/check_links_tests.rs`.
- `plan_profile_package_with_inputs` (`crates/jit/src/commands/profile.rs:811-845`) and `preview_resolved_profile_selection` (`:1275-1313`, serving `plan_profiles` through `plan_resolved_profile_selection` at `:1252`, and `diff_profiles_from_sources` at `:963`) open `with_mutation_session` and return `SessionStep::Done` over `prepare_profile_selection` (`:1362`), which takes `&mut dyn RepositoryMutationSession` and calls `capture_proposed_base`.
- `publish_package_tree(.., publish)` (`:584-639`) serves `add_profile_package` (`:531`) and `plan_profile_add` (`:541`); with `publish = false` it returns `SessionStep::Done` from the session that would publish. `publish_package_archive` (`:647-705`) serves `plan_profile_pack` (`:458`) through `plan_repository_export` (`crates/jit/src/commands/mod.rs:2265-2289`), which opens `with_mutation_session` and returns without applying. Dry runs are not recovery-dispatched (`crates/jit/src/cli.rs:2744`).
- The capture helpers take `&mut dyn RepositoryReadSession`, and `with_read_session` is the driver. A read-session open crosses `MutationPoint::ReadSessionOpen`, not `SessionOpen`; command tests race a writer at a session point through `with_session_race` (`crates/jit/src/commands/test_helpers.rs:132`).
- `test_package_tree_publication_has_one_owner_in_the_command_layer` (`crates/jit/tests/scratch_build/repository_state_cutover_tests.rs:1531-1548`) requires `commands/profile.rs` to contain exactly one `finalize_package_tree_capture(` call, exactly one `PackageTreeCapture::new(` call, and `fn publish_package_tree(`.
- `docs/reference/storage-format.md:96-100` says a read-only command opens no mutation session and reads files as they stand, which may be a partly applied state.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `capture_validation_image_with` and `capture_validation_report` run through `with_read_session`. The one-capture `--fix` derivation 1f24e3e9 introduces takes `&mut dyn RepositoryReadSession`; `--fix --dry-run` runs it through `with_read_session` and `--fix` through `with_mutation_session`, and both report the same fixes for the same repository. `repair_derived_state` stays for `jit recover` in its mutation session.
- [hard] REQ-02: `read_documents_at_named_versions` runs its capture and `read_documents` through `with_read_session`.
- [hard] REQ-03: `prepare_profile_selection` takes `&mut dyn RepositoryReadSession`; profile plans and difference reports run it through `with_read_session` and apply keeps running it through `with_mutation_session`. `publish_package_tree` and `plan_repository_export` derive through one function per operation over `&mut dyn RepositoryReadSession`; the dry runs call it through `with_read_session` and the publishing paths through `with_mutation_session`.
- [hard] REQ-04: None of these readers opens a mutation session except as the driver's fallback. A test that races a writer against a moved reader races it at `ReadSessionOpen`, since the reader no longer crosses `SessionOpen` outside the fallback. The package-tree derivation keeps one `finalize_package_tree_capture(` call and one `PackageTreeCapture::new(` call inside `fn publish_package_tree(`'s module, and the cutover test passes unchanged.
- [hard] REQ-05: A harness test shows that, while a mutation session is held open on another thread, the read completes and returns its result, for `validate_repository_report`, for `validate_with_fix(true, true)`, for a link check over one issue's documents, for a profile plan and for a `profile add` dry run.
- [hard] REQ-06: `docs/reference/storage-format.md` states the read admission rule once (no redo record was present and the event log did not grow), the locked fallback and its leftover-record error (the recovery-failed error), and lists the commands that read through the driver, starting with those this task moves; it keeps the no-session statement only for the commands it still describes, and `snapshot export` keeps its locked session.
- [hard] REQ-07: `jit validate` over a repository leaves no file behind and does not wait on a writer. 180e7f33 reproduced `jit validate` creating `.jit-bootstrap.lock` at the root of a fresh repository; `jit query available` and `jit issue search` do not.
- [hard] REQ-08: `jit invariant check` obtains its declarations through `with_read_session` and the lock-free capture; the storage loads it read them through before no longer serve it.

## Notes

- Behaviour change: `jit validate` and `jit validate --fix --dry-run` take no repository lock while uncontended, and complete a leftover redo record only through the driver's fallback.
- Behaviour change: `jit doc check-links` takes no repository lock while uncontended.
- Behaviour change: profile plans, difference reports and the add and pack dry runs take no repository lock while uncontended.
- `issue-scope-type` edits `check_document_links`, a different function from the one moved here; whichever lands second rebases.
- The archive, declaration and gate-preset tasks follow this one and each adds its own commands to the list.
- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: Validate, link checks and profile previews read through the read driver
